judul: Tempe vs telur: protein mana lebih tinggi?
judul_en: Tempeh vs egg: which has more protein?

adegan.vo: [curious] {p0}Tempe... | atau {p1}telur? | Protein siapa | yang lebih tinggi?
adegan.vo_en: Tempeh... | or egg? | Which one | has more protein?

adegan.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | {jawab}TEMPE! | [excited] Per seratus gram, | {label}tempe dua puluh gram protein, | telur cuma dua belas! | [whispers] Tapi awas, ada jebakan angka... | {teaser}di akhir video.
adegan.vo_en: The answer... | TEMPEH! | Per hundred grams, | tempeh has twenty grams of protein, | egg only twelve! | But careful, there's a number trap... | at the end of the video.

adegan.vo: [curious] Rahasianya? | {l0}Kedelai, | kacang yang kaya protein. | {l1}Lalu difermentasi | jamur Rhizopus... | [excited] {l2}jadi lebih gampang dicerna!
adegan.vo_en: The secret? | Soybeans, | a protein-rich bean. | Then fermented | by Rhizopus mould... | so it's easier to digest!

adegan.vo: [mischievously] Nah, ini jebakannya: | angka tadi per seratus gram. | {b0}Sebutir telur: tujuh setengah gram. | {b1}Sepotong tempe tipis: | cuma lima gram! | [laughs] Jadi... | {b2}makan tempenya dua potong!
adegan.vo_en: Now, here's the trap: | those numbers were per hundred grams. | One egg: seven and a half grams. | One thin slice of tempeh: | only five grams! | So... | eat two slices of tempeh!

adegan.vo: [playful] Tempe: murah, asli Indonesia, | tercatat sejak tahun seribu delapan ratusan! | Kirim ke temanmu | yang suka meremehkan tempe!
adegan.vo_en: Tempeh: cheap, truly Indonesian, | on record since the 1800s! | Send this to a friend | who looks down on tempeh!

fakta.klaim: Sebutir telur (±60 g) berisi ±7,6 g protein.
fakta.klaim_en: One egg (~60 g) has ~7.6 g protein.

fakta.klaim: Sepotong tempe tipis (±25 g) berisi ±5,1 g protein.
fakta.klaim_en: A thin slice of tempeh (~25 g) has ~5.1 g protein.

fakta.klaim: Telur ayam utuh mentah mengandung 12,6 g protein per 100 g.
fakta.klaim_en: Whole raw egg has 12.6 g protein per 100 g.

fakta.klaim: Rujukan tertulis tertua tentang tempe ada di Serat Centhini (±1815).
fakta.klaim_en: The oldest written reference to tempeh is in the Serat Centhini (~1815).

fakta.klaim: Tempe dibuat dari kedelai yang difermentasi kapang Rhizopus; fermentasi membuatnya lebih mudah dicerna.
fakta.klaim_en: Tempeh is soybean fermented by Rhizopus mould, which makes it easier to digest.

fakta.klaim: Tempe mengandung 20,3 g protein per 100 g.
fakta.klaim_en: Tempeh has 20.3 g protein per 100 g.
